correctness.rationale: The missing-corner lemma follows directly from the original zero-neighbor requirement and two pairwise independent color matchings. For p<q it rules out any color of fewer than p cells; the two injections count by genuine inclusion-exclusion with color classes distinguished. For p=q it allows only p or p-1 cells per color. The mandatory opposite-color corner condition is necessary and sufficient. The three mutually disjoint cases are counted by n!D_n, 2n n!D_(n-1), and n n! (n-1)D_(n-2), respectively, with boundary derangements D0=1 and D1=0. A separate brute-force implementation applies actual rook adjacency and 2RiDF definition, corroborating formulas on stated finite domains. No unproved extrapolation or finite-to-infinite inference is used.

originality.rationale: The original full 2017 mathematical paper introduces the precisely matching two-rainbow independent definition and proves only the general three-factor Hamming reduction and parameter results for other families; this does not supply the exact cardinality enumerator. The inspected 2021 and full 2023 papers concern global parameter inequalities and cycles/path products, not the two-clique rook family. Searches of equivalent three-dimensional Hamming/maximal independent set phrasing and mathematical records located no covering statement. The claim establishes a full structural classification and derangement coefficients not implied by the inspected general reductions. Priority remains bounded, with explicitly documented risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed formula for independent dominating sets of three-factor Hamming graphs with one factor K_2, perhaps under nonattacking three-dimensional rook arrangements, could cover the claim.

value.rationale: The full cardinality enumerator addresses a natural entire family of 2-rainbow independent dominating functions and, via a published bijection, the graded maximal-independent-set family in 3D Hamming graphs with one binary coordinate. It shows rigid single-weight distributions on all nonsquare rectangles versus a precisely quantified three-weight spectrum on squares, with an exceptional n=3 missing minimal coefficient. Derangement and injection structure provides a substantive classification beyond known minimum-weight bounds or routine small-case recomputation.
